answer: Rule: every identity locks 50 units and posts its work to a public mirror ledger. An echo detector compares each new output against all past work; a copy burns the copier's deposit. One quill signs one genuine record, so a farm of 100 fakes must lock 5,000 units and produce 100 distinct pieces of real work. Deposit cost scales linearly, work cost scales with every fake, and shared output is worthless.
